_comment: Save yours via ComfyUI -> Workflow -> 'Save (API Format)' and drop it in here.
Node ids below are only defaults for a stock checkpoint loader + KSampler.
The CLI rebinds inputs by NAME (e.g. '6.text', '4.steps'), so you can
rearrange the graph as long as those input names survive.
